in_hebrew.name: Eden
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Eden הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. In the Bible, Eden refers to the garden where God placed Adam and Eve, the first humans, until they sinned. The name Eden thus represents a place of pure delight and pleasure in God's presence, a symbol of innocence and paradise.

in_latin.name: Eden
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Eden derivatur a vocabulo Hebraico Eden, quod significat 'dulcis' vel 'amoenus'. In Scriptura Sacra, Hortus Eden est primus mundus creatus a Deo, ubi habitabant Adam et Eva. Hortus Eden est symbolum pacis, harmoniae, et salutis. In traditione Christiana, Hortus Eden repraesentat regnum spirituale Dei et perfectio humanitatis.
